string.name: desktop_model_reasoning_help_text
string.value: The API value is sent in the request's reasoning-effort field, such as OpenAI's reasoning_effort. It defaults to the level name; where the model provider's API documentation specifies a different value, follow it. Off turns reasoning off and needs no value; a value already written in the configuration is kept and sent.

string.name: desktop_model_reasoning_needs_level
string.value: Add at least one level besides Off, or turn reasoning levels off.

string.name: desktop_model_reasoning_needs_value
string.value: Every level besides Off needs an API value, and no value can be empty.

string.name: desktop_model_reasoning_levels_only
string.value: This API protocol accepts only the minimal, low, medium, and high levels, each with its level name as the API value. Change or remove the other levels.
